Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: Defines patient dental appointments with clinical specifications and doctor verification status

phone.description: Patient telephone contact number for arrival updates

serviceId.description: The selected dental treatment identifier (e.g. cosmetic, implant, pediatric)

timeSlot.description: Precision clock hours assigned by the patient or doctor

notes.description: Patient-specified clinical symptoms, allergies or dental notes

status.description: Verification state to shield against spam and schedule arrivals cleanly

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment request was originally placed

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last modification by the clinic coordinator or doctor

Review.title: Review
Review.description: Public feedback and ratings left by verified clinic patients

patientName.description: Public display name of the patient

commentAr.description: Patient feedback text in Arabic (Bilingual target)

/appointments/{appointmentId}.description: Collection storing all dental appointment registrations

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Collection storing bilingual public patient reviews
